recentItems.title: Communities and NGOs encouraged to support students during exams
recentItems.description:
Matric exams start tomorrow, with learners from under-resourced communities facing more than just the pressure of studying. 

The lack of stationery, study materials, food, reliable transport and safe study spaces are making exam preparation more difficult.

But with the right support, communities and NGOs can help lift those burdens. 

We are joined via video link by Kevin Davis, Encounter Hope Operations Manager to discuss just how communities and NGOs can support them during this critical period.

recentItems.title: A 36-year-old pastor expected in the Atteridgeville Magistrates’ Court alongside his two wives
recentItems.description:
The alleged 36-year-old pastor is expected to make his first appearance at the Atteridgeville Magistrates’ Court today, following allegations that he murdered a four-month-old baby and raped the infant’s 43-year-old mother. He is expected to appear alongside his two wives, who made their first court appearance on Friday. The case relates to an alleged incident near the Hennops River in Atteridgeville, where the mother and her baby had reportedly accompanied the pastor and one of his wives.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
